<font color="#2E7D32">━━ Green</font> = Local process / IPC (never leaves workstation)
<font color="#C62828">━━ Red</font> = External HTTPS API call (may carry project / customer data)
<font color="#E65100">━━ Orange</font> = Local data persistence (filesystem writes/reads)
<font color="#6A1B9A">━━ Purple</font> = Logging / observability
<font color="#757575">- - Gray dashed</font> = Operational (installs, dependencies — no customer data)

<b>Encryption</b>
In transit: all external calls HTTPS / TLS 1.2+
At rest: workstation full-disk encryption (FileVault / OS-managed)

<b>Not applicable (no cloud infra operated by this system)</b>

OPENROUTER_API_KEY
FOUNDRY_TOKEN
(git-ignored)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="250" x="1150" y="660" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="scope_notes" parent="boundary" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF3E0;strokeColor=#E65100;fontSize=10;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;" value="<b>SOC 2 scope notes</b>

• <b>System boundary:</b> this CLI and its local artifacts on the operator workstation. No servers, VPCs, subnets, AZs, load balancers, WAF, or KMS are operated by this system (N/A). No dev/staging environments exist; the bundled demo/ project (synthetic data) is out of scope.
• <b>Admin access path:</b> engineer → local terminal → CLI. No SSH, no remote administrative surface, no listening ports.
• <b>Data protection:</b> validation + hidden-holdout actuals are sealed outside agent worktrees; agents may only edit solution/; raw project data is never copied into worktrees; holdout scored only at the final gate.
• <b>Logging / monitoring:</b> per-agent JSONL logs, run state.json, per-token cost ledger with --max-cost budget cap.
• <b>Backup / recovery:</b> every agent session is snapshot-committed to git; the research/ notebook is committed with the project repo.
• <b>Documented control for untrusted models:</b> run inside a container or VM (README guidance)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="260" width="1400" x="40" y="880" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="or_plane" parent="1" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;rounded=0;startSize=42;fillColor=#FCE4EC;strokeColor=#C62828;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;strokeWidth=2;" value="OpenRouter (LLM API Gateway — subservice organization)

div.div:
Edge colors
━━ Green = Local process / IPC (never leaves workstation)
━━ Red = External HTTPS API call (may carry project / customer data)
━━ Orange = Local data persistence (filesystem writes/reads)
━━ Purple = Logging / observability
- - Gray dashed = Operational (installs, dependencies — no customer data)
Encryption
In transit: all external calls HTTPS / TLS 1.2+
At rest: workstation full-disk encryption (FileVault / OS-managed)
Not applicable (no cloud infra operated by this system)
AWS Org/account, Region, VPC, subnets, AZs, IGW/NAT,
ALB/WAF/CloudFront, security groups, KMS, CloudTrail/GuardDuty

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 248, 225), rgb(30, 24, 4)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 143, 0), rgb(187, 91, 0));

div.div:
SOC 2 scope notes
• System boundary: this CLI and its local artifacts on the operator workstation. No servers, VPCs, subnets, AZs, load balancers, WAF, or KMS are operated by this system (N/A). No dev/staging environments exist; the bundled demo/ project (synthetic data) is out of scope.
• Admin access path: engineer → local terminal → CLI. No SSH, no remote administrative surface, no listening ports.
• Data protection: validation + hidden-holdout actuals are sealed outside agent worktrees; agents may only edit solution/; raw project data is never copied into worktrees; holdout scored only at the final gate.
• Logging / monitoring: per-agent JSONL logs, run state.json, per-token cost ledger with --max-cost budget cap.
• Backup / recovery: every agent session is snapshot-committed to git; the research/ notebook is committed with the project repo.
• Documented control for untrusted models: run inside a container or VM (README guidance).
